products.description: Jewelry with precious and semi-precious stones

faqs.question: Do you buy gold jewelry?
faqs.answer: Yes, we buy gold jewelry at competitive market rates. Bring your items for a free evaluation.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranties on jewelry?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our jewelry comes with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Custom pieces have a 6-month warranty.

faqs.question: Can I trade in my old jewelry?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We accept trade-ins. The value depends on the weight, purity, and condition of your jewelry.

faqs.question: Do you have payment plans?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer installment plans for purchases over 10,000 сом. Ask our staff for details.

faqs.question: How long does custom design take?
faqs.answer: Custom jewelry design typically takes 2-4 weeks depending on complexity. We'll provide an exact timeline during consultation.

faqs.question: Do you resize rings on the same day?
faqs.answer: Simple resizing can often be done within 1-2 hours if we're not busy. Complex resizing may take 1-2 days.

faqs.question: What purity of gold do you sell?
faqs.answer: We primarily work with 14k (585) and 18k (750) gold. We can also source 22k and 24k gold upon request.
